blocks.html: All equipment listed in ASME A17.1/CSA B44, Section 8.3 as modified by New York City Building Code, Appendix K, Chapter K1, shall be listed by an approved agency in accordance with Section 28-113.2.3 of the Administrative Code, Section 8.3.1 of ASME A17.1/CSA B44, and the rules of the department, and shall be approved by the commissioner.
